A first general finding is that the budget balance deteriorated by 2.7% of GDP (or € 18 billion) between 2016 and 2025, while the primary balance worsened by 3.3% of GDP (or € 21 billion)
ref.note: The primary balance leaves out interest, which fell by € 4 billion over the period (same page).

ref.quote: A second finding is that the deterioration of the primary balance since 2016 can be attributed to both lower revenue (€ 12 billion) and higher primary expenditure (€ 9 billion).
